SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%pneumonia%'
  AND VALIDity_PERIOD_START > '1900-01-01'
ORDER BY standard_concept DESC;
